## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, `python -m pytest` passes
- [ ] `ruff check src tests` passes
- [ ] Server-side validation for new inputs; CSRF on new forms
- [ ] No new dependency (or the reason is explained above)
- [ ] Schema change is a new migration (if any)
- [ ] Exports / JSON backup updated (if data is stored per report)
- [ ] README / CHANGELOG updated
- [ ] Screenshots for UI changes
- [ ] No client data, real targets or secrets in code, tests or screenshots
